answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an agent must provide sustained, verifiable service to keep its EigenTrust score above the consensus threshold; a delta in activity predictably reduces its influence. A fresh sybil has no trusted incoming paths, leaving its eigenvector centrality near zero, and reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify unsupported claims. Quill-signed receipts can document service, but identities remain below the consensus ledge until peers validate them.
